cues.text: The Squaresoft logo appears against black.
Map lettering overlays ornate towers and rounded stone structures.
The map sweeps over giant roots and green vines.
A many-spired wooden airship emerges through orange mist.
Blue energy erupts beneath a violet moon.
Blue rings spiral over clouds.
A map overlays golden cliffs and stone arches.
Blue crystal.
Final Fantasy Nine.
Opening credits appear against darkness.
A small sailboat pitches on a rain-lashed sea.
Hooded figures huddle inside the wooden boat.
Waves surge around its torn sail and mast.
Spray crashes over the boat.
A dark-haired girl opens her eyes in a sunlit room.
She wipes her eyes and approaches the curtains.
She peers outside, wearing a jeweled hair ornament.
Orange rooftops surround a castle beside a bay.
White birds sweep through the sky.
A winged stone figure overlooks the city.
A lantern-topped tower rises from an ornate wooden airship.
The airship sails above the mist.
A white bird glides alongside its glowing windows.
Inside, a blond boy carries a candle down a wooden passage.
A pointed-hat figure watches an airship from a crowded street.
The small figure looks up, two yellow eyes glowing.
People hurry over the sunlit cobblestones.
The ornate airship rises above the rooftops.
White castle towers overlook the sprawling city.
The title appears: Final Fantasy Nine.
Conceived and produced by Hironobu Sakaguchi.
Blue and red moons hang above a candlelit castle.
A glowing theater faces rows of spectators.
The small pointed-hat figure peers over the audience.
A heavily jeweled, crowned woman grins.
The dark-haired girl lowers her eyes beside an armored knight.
The stage lights brighten before the crowd.
Green and gold fireworks shower around the theater.
The pointed-hat figure leans forward to watch.
The knight folds his arms; the girl looks down.
Glittering fireworks frame the crowned woman's balcony.
On the battlements, a white-hooded girl faces the blond boy.
Red diamonds edge her hood; she smiles at him.
The armored knight reaches out over the parapet.
The girl leaps outward, her cloak billowing.
The boy springs after her.
They slide down a line toward the theater ship.
The knight's armored boot follows along the line.
The wooden theater ship hangs beside ornate castle towers.
A winged stone statue stands beneath glowing windows.
The crowned woman raises an arm toward the ship.
Heavy chains pull taut around the airship.
Bursts of fire and smoke erupt across its deck.
The crowned woman leans forward, watching it burn.
The blond boy and knight brace beside a railing.
Orange flame swells into a blinding explosion.
Smoke trails over the castle and the damaged theater ship.
The crowned woman watches from her balcony.
The smoking airship drifts between the towers.
Fire pours from its glowing wooden cabin.
The dark-haired girl clings beside broken railings.
The crowned woman's eyes widen beneath her jeweled crown.
The ship vanishes into low storm clouds.
It lurches past the city towers.
The smoking airship descends toward a dark forest.
Its hull drops between the treetops.
An orange explosion flares behind silhouetted pines.
Figures run between enormous moss-covered trunks.
Huge red blossoms fill the dark canopy.
The armored knight runs, carrying the dark-haired girl.
Thorny vines lash across the path.
Vines trap the red-haired man against a trunk.
A rolled scroll flies toward the blond boy.
He leaps past grasping vines.
He crawls out onto the grass.
The knight carries the girl behind him.
Thick vines and trunks turn pale and rigid.
Dust hangs over the gray, motionless forest.
A balloon airship cruises above mist-filled canyons.
A dark winged figure watches it pass.
Orange eyes glow beneath the hat.
Blue lightning lashes the balloon airship.
Small hatted figures are hurled across its shattered deck.
Lightning crackles around a dark, feathered figure.
A limp, gloved hand falls past the rail.
The small blue-coated figure raises both hands.
The blond boy grips the wheel beside the dark-haired girl.
The winged figure folds its arms.
The airship speeds through a narrow rocky gorge.
The pointed-hat figure faces its winged pursuer.
The dark-haired girl grips the wheel beside the knight.
The pursuer gathers a brilliant ball of blue light.
The blond boy braces himself against the wooden rail.
He climbs up as the ship rushes toward enormous gates.
The winged figure hurtles through the stone passage.
Flames engulf its outstretched wings.
The airship bursts from the gateway trailing smoke.
A sprawling fortress city crowns a rocky peak.
Airships weave between its tall cylindrical towers.
Huge clock faces overlook crowded streets and bridges.
A small yellow airship slips past the buildings.
The balloon ship passes a vast clockwork tower.
Stone columns border a sunlit terrace.
The blond boy steps onto the terrace and stops.
White birds gather around the dark-haired girl's hands.
She turns from the wall toward him.
She looks upward as the birds take flight.
The flock circles through the bright blue sky.
Rain falls across ornate, deserted stone terraces.
Boots step over carved stonework.
The blond boy sits slumped; a red-coated figure lies nearby.
A long, silver-haired figure raises a gloved hand.
The red-coated figure pushes up from the ground.
A huge white bird lowers its long beak.
The red-coated figure raises a hand toward it.
The white bird rises into the glowing sky.
A blue light blazes above a cloud-wrapped tree.
A leafy platform supports a small, vine-covered pavilion.
Bright fragments whirl around a brilliant blue beam.
Luminous rings spiral down around the treetop.
The light fades, leaving a green crown above the clouds.
A violet orb flares before the crowned woman.
A beam pierces a dark red cloud above the sea.
A rider on a black horse emerges in brilliant light.
The black horse plunges forward, its rider's cloak streaming.
They descend toward a round, densely wooded city.
Buildings shatter in a spreading golden explosion.
The mounted silhouette rises against the burning sky.
The crowned woman grins broadly.
Airships bombard a city of towers and bridges.
Explosions light the city behind the crowned woman.
Armored guards hold a gateway beneath glowing lamps.
Pointed-hat figures advance, their yellow eyes glowing.
Purple bolts and bright blasts cross the street.
A hatted figure raises a gloved hand amid the flames.
Fire engulfs buildings and packed crowds below.
The blond boy and dark-haired girl watch from tall grass.
A vast wooden airship hangs beside the city.
Walls and machinery crumble into the storm.
Broken masonry spirals toward a bright red vortex.
The crowned woman watches from her ship.
On the hillside, the dark-haired girl lowers her head.
The blond boy puts an arm around her shoulders.
Huge tangled roots support a tree's domed crown.
The view draws back across the root-covered landscape.
Dense green forest stretches beneath drifting clouds.
The mist clears beside a bright castle on rocky cliffs.
Beyond the cliffs, the domed tree stands alone.
Wind blows the dark-haired girl's hair across her face.
Craggy cliffs tower above the wooded coast.
A red eye glows above burning ships.
Smoke and drifting embers engulf the shoreline.
A tremendous wave surges over a small boat.
A hooded child's face appears in the rain.
Fire spreads beneath the eye suspended in the smoke.
A glowing ring expands into a whirlpool of flame.
A brilliant streak plunges toward a tree-covered island.
A silver-haired figure stands between a pale bird and dragon.
The dragon opens its fanged mouth around a glowing light.
Magenta light strikes the shore in a huge explosion.
The dark dragon wheels over the sea.
The silver-haired figure brushes windblown hair from their face.
The silver-haired figure looks upward; a vast red eye glows.
Purple tendrils stream from the eye around the ships.
A pointed-hat figure stands amid the violet light.
The crowned woman faces the enormous dragon.
Her mouth falls open as golden sparks surround it.
A blast tears through the deck behind fleeing soldiers.
Wreckage burns in a roaring orange fireball.
The silver-haired figure rides the pale bird away.
The dark-haired girl descends sunlit stone steps.
She pauses beside the lake, gazing across the water.
Castle towers shimmer in the rippling reflection.
Slender white spires rise into the morning sky.
A dark dragon launches fire through the night.
Buildings explode; the dark-haired girl watches from the palace.
Her eyes widen as flames light her face.
The dragon towers above the rooftops, wreathed in embers.
Dark castle spires frame the stormy sky.
A small blue-haired girl floats downward in green light.
The dark-haired girl's pendant glows brilliantly.
The blue-haired girl reaches toward her through the light.
Green radiance envelops them beneath the violet moon.
A beam rises from the city beneath a purple moon.
Enormous feathered wings unfold from the castle.
People stare upward from the streets below.
A stream of fire pours down toward the towers.
Blue points of light spread across the winged fortress.
The small blue-haired girl closes her eyes.
Lances of blue energy converge on the flying dragon.
A brilliant blue explosion expands between the feathered wings.
The winged castle sends a blue beam into the clouds.
A fiery red eye opens, then becomes a patterned disc.
Giant pale wings curl around the castle towers.
A glowing sphere emerges through mist.
A red mechanical eye faces the castle's glowing wings.
The two girls stand together beneath the stormy sky.
Blue lightning crawls around the dark-haired girl's pendant.
She clutches her chest as the light intensifies.
A blue beam tears through the castle tower.
Stone bridges crack and crumble into the smoke.
The blond boy leaps across the broken bridge to the girl.
He springs away from the falling stones, carrying her.
She closes her eyes against his shoulder.
Above them, the small blue-haired girl clings to a rope.
Intricate white circles form around the blazing red eye.
A violet beam engulfs the winged castle.
Fire swallows the city.
The dark-haired girl raises a dagger behind her head.
She slices through her long hair.
The severed ponytail slips from her hand.
Sunlight washes over the castle beside the lake.
The blond boy watches, mouth open.
With her hair now short, she smiles at him.
A massive airship waits in a cavernous hangar.
It glides outward past hanging cranes.
The airship flies away between pale castle towers.
An airship hovers above an icy island.
Green and gold lights form a vast, swirling passage.
The ship tilts downward into the glowing shaft.
The short-haired girl reaches toward another falling figure.
Figures tumble through a bright, swirling tunnel.
Streams of colored light dissolve into white.
The short-haired girl approaches a railing above a blue city.
An ornate purple and gold airship floats before them.
The blond boy looks up beside her.
A giant red eye looms, then burning ships appear.
The image returns to the girl's face; her eyes close.
A figure floats before a giant pink sphere.
Red hair and feathers frame their pale face.
Purple streaks slash through the blue city's towers.
Beams tear apart bridges and floating platforms.
Explosions spread between mushroom-shaped towers.
Fire and falling debris engulf the enormous pink sphere.
The red-haired figure spreads their arms amid the flames.
An orange eye glows on the prow of a dark airship.
The ship dives between burning towers and falling wreckage.
The ornate blue airship weaves through the shattered city.
It plunges into a white ring of light.
A glowing sphere erupts from the storm-tossed sea.
The blue airship bursts from the light and skims the waves.
A pink vortex glows over a craggy mass in the clouds.
Pale dragons pour from the swirling light.
They surround a small, brightly colored airship.
Through its curved window, countless dragons fill the sky.
A fleet of larger airships emerges from the clouds.
Cannons flash; orange explosions tear through the swarm.
Dragons wheel between the firing ships.
An enormous hull pushes through the clouds.
Airships fire their cannons into swarms of pale dragons.
Fireballs burst among the diving creatures.
The colorful airship speeds toward the glowing pink vortex.
Pale dragons close in around its tail.
A wooden airship blocks their path.
The ornate airship flies through purple clouds.
It dives into the brilliant pink vortex.
Other airships follow into the blinding light.
The blond boy stands beneath an airship at sunset.
The short-haired girl looks down from its open doorway.
The ship rises above the rocky clearing, leaving him below.
Figures watch from the railing as it pulls away.
The boy turns away beneath a fiery orange sky.
The dark-haired girl, wearing a white gown, leaves the balcony.
The knight and a long-haired swordswoman stand aside.
The swordswoman bows her head; the girl runs through the doorway.
She hurries down the stone stairs toward a crowded square.
She pushes between the spectators, her long skirt streaming.
She squeezes past an armored figure and looks ahead.
Her jeweled pendant falls onto the cobblestones.
Leaving it behind, she rushes toward the stage.
She throws her arms around the blond boy.
She pounds his chest, then clings to him.
He holds her close as the crowd applauds.
A red-haired man and masked figures clap from a balcony.
The knight puts an arm around the swordswoman.
The couple embrace before the cheering city.
Words appear: Our song. I sang your song.
Restored castle towers rise above the sunlit city.
The sunlit city spreads beside the lake and mountains.
Closing credits appear beside still images from the adventure.
The embracing couple reappears beside the final credits.
Blue and red worlds merge in a dazzling white glow.
Streams of light converge into a sparkling crystal.
The crystal becomes the title: Final Fantasy Nine.
